entries.zh: 劝导；教导，告诫
entries.en: to advise; to counsel, to admonish

entries.zh: 恳切详细地规劝；有条理地好言相劝
entries.en: to advise well and in detail; to counsel earnestly and methodically
entries.notes: 「款曲」本谓委曲详尽、情意恳切，据 L 栏「con orden」（有条理）推为详细规劝。

entries.zh: 善加教化；以善道劝导使人向善
entries.en: to advise well and in good order; to guide someone to goodness

entries.zh: 教唆，出坏主意；引人入邪
entries.en: to give bad advice; to counsel evil, to lead astray
entries.notes: 「畔」单字义晦，疑借作「叛」，指蛊惑、引人背逆，与 L 栏「aconsejar mal」相应。

entries.zh: （父亲对儿子）训示、作主指教
entries.en: to instruct authoritatively (a father laying down the law to his son)
entries.notes: L 栏「P.e」为「Padre」之缩写；「主張」兼有作主、定夺之义，故释为带权威的训导。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H、R 两栏皆空，L 栏仅作「[Acontecer / Acordarse]」之存疑拟题，M 栏「prǔter.」无从比定，材料不足。

entries.zh: 习惯；使习惯于
entries.en: to accustom; to be accustomed

entries.zh: 习以为常；因反复而惯熟
entries.en: to be inured to; to become habitual through repetition
entries.notes: 「荐」有屡次、重复之义，故「慣荐」谓反复实践而成习。

entries.zh: 熟习；熟练而习惯
entries.en: to be well accustomed to; to be practiced and familiar with

entries.zh: 习惯，惯于（「世」当作「勢」，即「慣勢」）
entries.en: to be accustomed to; to be used to
entries.notes: 「慣世」之「世」当为「勢」之借字，合为「慣勢」，义即习惯。

entries.zh: 十分习惯；深惯于此
entries.en: to be thoroughly accustomed; to accustom greatly
entries.notes: 「慣滿」搭配于常见文献罕见，取「滿」之充分义，据 L 栏「mucho」定其程度。

entries.zh: 已经习惯了
entries.en: already accustomed; to have grown used to

entries.zh: 操劳；自幼用心费力于劳作
entries.en: to take pains (with work); to inure oneself to labor from childhood
entries.notes: 「操心」本谓费心忧虑，与 L 栏「自童年起习惯于劳作」略有偏移，取其操劳用心之义。

entries.zh: 锻炼；磨练成习
entries.en: to train oneself; to harden oneself by practice
entries.notes: L 栏末「quere costumbre」疑为「quiere costumbre」（养成习惯）之讹写。

entries.zh: 鹞；苍鹰一类猛禽
entries.en: goshawk; a hawk (bird of prey)

entries.zh: 鞭打；责打
entries.en: to whip, to flog; to beat
entries.notes: 「(vay.)」为来源缩略标记，未能确定所指；「打」为泛称，较 açotar 之鞭责略宽。

entries.zh: 打中；责打着（「着」为结果补语）
entries.en: to strike home; to lay blows on

entries.zh: 游街责打；押解着当街鞭打示众
entries.en: to flog (an offender) through the streets; public whipping in the streets

entries.zh: 捆绑后责打（对官员施以一次鞭责）
entries.en: to bind and flog; to give a mandarin a lashing
entries.notes: 「綑打」为捆缚而打，L 栏则谓对官员鞭责一次，二者侧重不同，姑并存。

entries.zh: 惩戒性地责打；为纠正而责打
entries.en: to beat as correction; to flog for chastisement
entries.notes: 「端打」字面为打而使端正，与 L 栏「corrigiendo」（为纠正而打）相应，惟「端」此义罕见。
